docket_entries.description: SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF CHEN, SHI AS TO DEFENDANT HA, PHOEBE
ORDER FOR CONTINUANCE RE PROGRESS REPORT
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-05-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CHEN, SHI RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HA, PHOEBE $12,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $12,590.00, JUDGMENT FOR PLAINTIFF AND AGAINST DEFENDANT STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $12,500.00 FILED BY CHEN, SHI AS TO DEFENDANT HA, PHOEBE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-07-2025 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-07-2025 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO NOV-05-2025 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PARTIES REACHED AN AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT WILL START MAKING PAYMENT OF $1000 EACH MONTH STARTING SEPTEMBER 1, 2025. IF 2 CONSECUTIVE PAYMENTS ARE MISSED THE ENTIRE AMOUNT OF $12,500 WILL BECOME DUE AND PAYABLE IMMEDIATELY AND THE JUDGMENT AGAINST DEFENDANT WILL GO INTO EFFECT. THE CASE IS SET FOR 3 MONTHS FROM TODAY'S DATE FOR STATUS CONFERENCE TO MAKE SURE PAYMENTS ARE MADE IN A TIMELY MANNER. THE PARTIES DO NOT HAVE TO APPEAR IN COURT IF THERE IS NO PROBLEM. BUT IF 2 CONSECUTIVE PAYMENTS ARE MISSED, THEN PLAINTIFF CAN RETURN TO COURT AND ASKS THE COURT TO ACCELERATE THE JUDGMENT. LAST PAYMENT IS ON SEPTEMBER 1, 2026, FOR $500.00. IF DEFENDANT MAKE ALL PAYMENTS AND PLAINTIFF IS SATISFIED AND RECEIVES THE #12,500 OWED TO HER. THEN THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE & ON OCTOBER 1. 2026. THERE WILL BE NO JUDGMENT AGAINST THE DEFENDANT. BY VISITING JUDGE TAMILA IPEMA. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ABSTRACT OF JUDGMENT FILED BY PLAINTIFF CHEN, SHI AS TO DEFENDANT HA, PHOEBE
